title: Dimension reduction with all hypotheses
promptMarkdown: Prove that every compact smooth $n$-manifold with $n\ge1$ embeds in $\mathbb R^{2n+1}$ and immerses in $\mathbb R^{2n}$. You may use the finite-dimensional embedding constructed in unit 5 and smooth Sard. Construct $P(TM)$ through its bundle charts, identify both bad-direction maps, and explain why the proof stops at different dimensions for the two conclusions.
hintLadder: Turn the tangent bundle transition matrices into projective transitions.
Keep the target direction dimension $N-1$ separate from the projected target dimension.
Repeat the topology step after each injective projection.
